settings.editor: Clara joined her father at the agency in 2014 and became a partner five years later. She does every valuation in the Old Town herself, and shows every home she takes on.

“I was eleven when my father let me hold the tape measure. What I learned from him is that a house is worth what someone will pay for it on a Tuesday in the rain, and that telling a seller anything else is a kindness that costs them money.”

Clara is a Fellow of the national association of estate agents and sits on the board of the Old Town conservation trust.

settings.title: Thinking of selling? Start with what it is worth.

settings.editor: A partner visits, looks properly and tells you a figure we would be happy to be held to. It takes an hour and costs nothing.
